summary: Embed other apps' widgets directly into your site pages.

features.title: App widgets in your pages
features.short: Embed another app's widget in a site page
features.description: Apps that offer a widget — QueueDesk's booking page, for example — can be placed inside a page as an App widget block, so visitors book, browse or read inside your own site instead of following a link to a separate address. Without a subscription the block is listed but cannot be added; every other block type and everything else in the app works exactly the same.
